+"""Test basic centre functionality."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+from playbill import centre
+
+
+def test_centre_simple():
+    """A short line is centered with spaces before it."""
+    result = centre("hi", 10)
+    # Spare space = 10 - 2 = 8, half = 4
+    assert result == "    hi"
+    assert len(result) == 6  # 4 spaces + 2 chars
+
+
+def test_centre_exact_measure():
+    """A line exactly the measure width is unchanged."""
+    result = centre("hello", 5)
+    assert result == "hello"
+
+
+def test_centre_wider_than_measure():
+    """A line wider than measure is unchanged."""
+    result = centre("longerword", 5)
+    assert result == "longerword"
+
+
+def test_centre_single_char():
+    """A single character is centered."""
+    result = centre("a", 5)
+    # Spare space = 5 - 1 = 4, half = 2
+    assert result == "  a"
+    assert len(result) == 3
+
+
+def test_centre_even_spare_space():
+    """Even spare space is split evenly."""
+    result = centre("ab", 10)
+    # Spare space = 10 - 2 = 8, half = 4
+    assert result == "    ab"
+    assert len(result) == 6
+
+
+def test_centre_odd_spare_space_rounds_down():
+    """Odd spare space rounds down (line leans left)."""
+    result = centre("abc", 10)
+    # Spare space = 10 - 3 = 7, half = 3 (rounded down from 3.5)
+    assert result == "   abc"
+    assert len(result) == 6
+
+
+def test_centre_empty_string():
+    """Empty string is centered (all spaces)."""
+    result = centre("", 5)
+    # Spare space = 5 - 0 = 5, half = 2
+    assert result == "  "
+    assert len(result) == 2
+
+
+def test_centre_no_spaces_after():
+    """Nothing is added after the line."""
+    result = centre("x", 10)
+    # Should be "    x" with no trailing spaces
+    assert result == "    x"
+    assert len(result) == 5
+    assert not result.endswith(" ")
+
+
+def test_centre_result_ends_where_line_ends():
+    """Centered result ends where the original line ends."""
+    line = "test"
+    result = centre(line, 20)
+    # Should be 8 spaces + 4 chars = 12 total
+    assert result.endswith(line)
+    assert result.rstrip() == result  # No trailing spaces

+"""Test centre edge cases and special scenarios."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+from playbill import centre
+
+
+def test_centre_double_width_line():
+    """A line that's twice as wide as measure is unchanged."""
+    result = centre("verylongword", 5)
+    assert result == "verylongword"
+    assert len(result) == 12
+
+
+def test_centre_multiple_words():
+    """A multi-word line is treated as a single unit."""
+    result = centre("hello world", 20)
+    # Spare space = 20 - 11 = 9, half = 4
+    assert result == "    hello world"
+    assert len(result) == 15
+
+
+def test_centre_line_with_spaces():
+    """A line containing spaces is centered as a whole."""
+    result = centre("a b c", 15)
+    # Spare space = 15 - 5 = 10, half = 5
+    assert result == "     a b c"
+    assert len(result) == 10
+
+
+def test_centre_all_spaces():
+    """A string of spaces is centered."""
+    result = centre("   ", 10)
+    # Spare space = 10 - 3 = 7, half = 3
+    assert result == "      "
+    assert len(result) == 6
+
+
+def test_centre_single_space():
+    """A single space is centered."""
+    result = centre(" ", 10)
+    # Spare space = 10 - 1 = 9, half = 4
+    assert result == "     "
+    assert len(result) == 5
+
+
+def test_centre_unicode_characters():
+    """Unicode characters are handled (length counted by Python)."""
+    result = centre("café", 10)
+    # Length of "café" is 4
+    # Spare space = 10 - 4 = 6, half = 3
+    assert result == "   café"
+    assert len(result) == 7
+
+
+def test_centre_measure_one():
+    """Measure of 1 centers single character."""
+    result = centre("a", 1)
+    assert result == "a"
+
+
+def test_centre_asymmetric_centering():
+    """When space is odd, line leans left (more space on right would be if there were space)."""
+    result = centre("ab", 9)
+    # Spare space = 9 - 2 = 7, half = 3 (rounded down)
+    # So 3 spaces before "ab"
+    assert result == "   ab"
+    # This means right side has 4 empty spaces if measure were filled
+    # Left side has 3 spaces, right side empty 4 spaces
+
+
+def test_centre_very_short_line():
+    """Very short line relative to measure."""
+    result = centre("x", 100)
+    # Spare space = 100 - 1 = 99, half = 49
+    assert result == " " * 49 + "x"
+    assert len(result) == 50
+
+
+def test_centre_tabs_in_line():
+    """Tabs in the line are preserved and counted."""
+    result = centre("a\tb", 10)
+    # Length of "a\tb" is 3
+    # Spare space = 10 - 3 = 7, half = 3
+    assert result == "   a\tb"

+"""Test centre measure validation."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+from playbill import centre
+
+
+def test_centre_measure_zero_raises_error():
+    """Measure of 0 raises ValueError."""
+    try:
+        centre("hello", 0)
+        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
+    except ValueError:
+        pass
+
+
+def test_centre_measure_negative_raises_error():
+    """Negative measure raises ValueError."""
+    try:
+        centre("hello", -1)
+        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
+    except ValueError:
+        pass
+
+
+def test_centre_measure_one_is_valid():
+    """Measure of 1 is valid."""
+    result = centre("x", 1)
+    assert result == "x"
+
+
+def test_centre_large_measure_is_valid():
+    """Large measure is valid."""
+    result = centre("test", 1000)
+    # Spare space = 1000 - 4 = 996, half = 498
+    assert result == " " * 498 + "test"
+
+
+def test_centre_error_raised_before_processing():
+    """ValueError is raised before any processing occurs."""
+    # Empty line with invalid measure should still raise error
+    try:
+        centre("", -1)
+        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
+    except ValueError:
+        pass

+"""Test basic set_bill functionality: word ordering and line fitting."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+from playbill import set_bill
+
+
+def test_single_word_fits():
+    """A single word fitting the measure returns one line."""
+    result = set_bill("hello", 10)
+    assert result == ["hello"]
+
+
+def test_single_word_exact_measure():
+    """A word exactly the measure width is returned as-is."""
+    result = set_bill("hello", 5)
+    assert result == ["hello"]
+
+
+def test_two_words_fit_together():
+    """Two words that fit together on one line appear on one line."""
+    result = set_bill("hello world", 12)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_two_words_fit_separately():
+    """Two words that don't fit together appear on separate lines."""
+    result = set_bill("hello world", 8)
+    assert result == ["hello", "world"]
+
+
+def test_multiple_words_grouped():
+    """Multiple words are grouped as many as fit per line."""
+    result = set_bill("a b c d e", 5)
+    assert result == ["a b c", "d e"]
+
+
+def test_word_order_preserved():
+    """Words appear in the order they were given."""
+    result = set_bill("first second third", 20)
+    assert result == ["first second third"]
+    # Verify order by splitting
+    words = " ".join(result).split()
+    assert words == ["first", "second", "third"]
+
+
+def test_three_word_lines():
+    """Three words on one line when they fit."""
+    result = set_bill("cat dog bird", 12)
+    assert result == ["cat dog bird"]
+
+
+def test_words_split_correctly():
+    """When reconstructed, words appear in original order."""
+    text = "the quick brown fox"
+    result = set_bill(text, 8)
+    reconstructed = " ".join(result)
+    original_words = text.split()
+    result_words = reconstructed.split()
+    assert original_words == result_words

+"""Test set_bill edge cases: empty text, whitespace-only text, wide words."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+from playbill import set_bill
+
+
+def test_empty_text():
+    """Empty text returns empty list."""
+    result = set_bill("", 10)
+    assert result == []
+
+
+def test_whitespace_only_text():
+    """Text with only whitespace returns empty list."""
+    result = set_bill("   ", 10)
+    assert result == []
+
+
+def test_text_with_tabs_only():
+    """Text with only tabs returns empty list."""
+    result = set_bill("\t\t\t", 10)
+    assert result == []
+
+
+def test_text_with_newlines_only():
+    """Text with only newlines returns empty list."""
+    result = set_bill("\n\n\n", 10)
+    assert result == []
+
+
+def test_text_with_mixed_whitespace_only():
+    """Text with only mixed whitespace returns empty list."""
+    result = set_bill("  \t\n  \t\n  ", 10)
+    assert result == []
+
+
+def test_word_wider_than_measure():
+    """A word wider than measure appears on its own line, wider than measure."""
+    result = set_bill("supercalifragilisticexpialidocious", 5)
+    assert result == ["supercalifragilisticexpialidocious"]
+    assert len(result[0]) > 5
+
+
+def test_word_wider_than_measure_followed_by_word():
+    """A wide word is followed by another word on next line."""
+    result = set_bill("supercalifragilisticexpialidocious small", 5)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert result[0] == "supercalifragilisticexpialidocious"
+    assert result[1] == "small"
+
+
+def test_multiple_wide_words():
+    """Multiple words wider than measure each get their own line."""
+    result = set_bill("supercalifragilisticexpialidocious antidisestablishmentarianism", 5)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert len(result[0]) > 5
+    assert len(result[1]) > 5
+
+
+def test_wide_word_between_normal_words():
+    """A wide word between normal words is properly isolated."""
+    result = set_bill("hello supercalifragilisticexpialidocious world", 5)
+    assert len(result) == 3
+    assert result[0] == "hello"
+    assert result[1] == "supercalifragilisticexpialidocious"
+    assert result[2] == "world"
+
+
+def test_line_exactly_at_measure():
+    """A line exactly at measure width is accepted."""
+    result = set_bill("1234 567", 8)  # "1234 567" is 8 chars
+    assert result == ["1234 567"]
+    assert len(result[0]) == 8
+
+
+def test_adding_one_more_char_exceeds_measure():
+    """Adding one more word would exceed measure."""
+    result = set_bill("1234 567 8", 8)  # "1234 567" fits, adding "8" would exceed
+    assert result == ["1234 567", "8"]
+
+
+def test_single_character_words():
+    """Single character words are handled correctly."""
+    result = set_bill("a b c d e f g", 7)
+    # "a b c d" = 7 chars, "e f g" = 5 chars
+    assert result == ["a b c d", "e f g"]
+
+
+def test_space_calculation_precision():
+    """Space calculation is exact: word fits if len(line) + 1 + len(word) <= measure."""
+    # measure = 10, "hello" = 5
+    # Line "hello" (5) + space (1) + word (3) = 9 <= 10, should fit
+    result = set_bill("hello bye", 10)
+    assert result == ["hello bye"]
+
+    # measure = 9
+    # Line "hello" (5) + space (1) + word (3) = 9 <= 9, should still fit
+    result = set_bill("hello bye", 9)
+    assert result == ["hello bye"]
+
+    # measure = 8
+    # Line "hello" (5) + space (1) + word (3) = 9 > 8, should not fit
+    result = set_bill("hello bye", 8)
+    assert result == ["hello", "bye"]

+"""Test set_bill whitespace handling."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
+
+from playbill import set_bill
+
+
+def test_leading_whitespace_ignored():
+    """Leading whitespace before the first word is ignored."""
+    result = set_bill("  hello world", 20)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_trailing_whitespace_ignored():
+    """Trailing whitespace after the last word is ignored."""
+    result = set_bill("hello world  ", 20)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_both_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_ignored():
+    """Both leading and trailing whitespace are ignored."""
+    result = set_bill("  hello world  ", 20)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_multiple_spaces_between_words():
+    """Multiple spaces between words are treated as single separator."""
+    result = set_bill("hello   world", 20)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_tabs_separate_words():
+    """Tabs separate words."""
+    result = set_bill("hello\tworld", 20)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_newlines_separate_words():
+    """Newlines separate words."""
+    result = set_bill("hello\nworld", 20)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_mixed_whitespace_separates():
+    """Mixed whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) separates words."""
+    result = set_bill("hello  \t\n  world", 20)
+    assert result == ["hello world"]
+
+
+def test_output_no_leading_spaces():
+    """Output lines have no leading spaces."""
+    result = set_bill("a b c d e", 5)
+    for line in result:
+        assert not line.startswith(" "), f"Line '{line}' starts with space"
+
+
+def test_output_no_trailing_spaces():
+    """Output lines have no trailing spaces."""
+    result = set_bill("a b c d e", 5)
+    for line in result:
+        assert not line.endswith(" "), f"Line '{line}' ends with space"
+
+
+def test_single_space_between_words():
+    """Words in output are separated by exactly one space."""
+    result = set_bill("one two three four", 10)
+    for line in result:
+        words = line.split()
+        # Reconstruct and check we have exactly one space between words
+        if len(words) > 1:
+            reconstructed = " ".join(words)
+            assert reconstructed == line
